name: Exp_WPR
summary: This EA trades based on the Williams' Percent Range (%R) indicator, entering long positions when %R indicates oversold conditions and short positions when it indicates overbought conditions. It implements a classic momentum mean-reversion strategy using WPR extremes as entry signals with configurable thresholds for buy and sell zones. The EA includes basic risk management with stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于威廉姆斯百分比范围(WPR)指标进行交易，在%R显示超卖条件时做多，在超买条件时做空。它使用WPR极值作为入场信号的经典动量均值回归策略，具有可配置的买卖区域阈值。EA包含基本的止损和止盈风险管理功能。
strategy_analysis: Exp_WPR是一个基于Williams' Percent Range (%R)振荡器的动量均值回归交易系统。入场条件为：当WPR指标进入超卖区域（低于设定的买入阈值）时开多单，当WPR进入超买区域（高于设定的卖出阈值）时开空单。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈水平，同时可能在WPR回到中性区域时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有动态仓位调整或资金管理算法。策略概念基于均值回归——当价格偏离到极端区域时预期会回归均值方向运动。该策略没有加入新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓，也没有传播过滤机制，在高波动市场可能面临滑点和虚假信号的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: Exp_WPR is a momentum mean-reversion trading system based on the Williams' Percent Range (%R) oscillator. Entry conditions are: open a long position when the WPR indicator enters the oversold zone (below a configurable buy threshold), and open a short position when WPR enters the overbought zone (above a configurable sell threshold). Exit conditions rely on preset stop loss and take profit levels, and may also close positions when WPR returns to neutral territory. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic position adjustment or money management algorithms. The strategy concept is rooted in mean reversion—expecting price to revert toward the mean when it reaches extreme levels. The EA lacks a new bar check mechanism, which could lead to multiple entries on the same candle, and it has no spread filter, making it vulnerable to slippage and false signals in high-volatility markets.

parameters.name: InpMagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，基于经典WPR指标，易于理解和验证
具有可配置的超买超卖阈值，交易者可根据市场条件灵活调整
包含止损和止盈设置，提供基本的风险保护机制
使用魔术编号区分订单，支持与其他EA同时运行
WPR是经过长期验证的振荡器指标，在区间市场中表现良好
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic based on the classic WPR indicator, easy to understand and verify
Configurable overbought/oversold thresholds allow traders to flexibly adjust based on market conditions
Includes stop loss and take profit settings, providing basic risk protection
Uses magic number to distinguish orders, supporting concurrent operation with other EAs
WPR is a long-validated oscillator indicator that performs well in range-bound markets
cons: 缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上多次开仓导致过度交易
没有传播过滤，在高点差市场环境下可能产生不利成交
固定手数没有资金管理逻辑，无法根据账户规模和风险动态调整
WPR在趋势市场中容易产生连续的虚假信号，导致连续亏损
没有移动止损或部分平仓机制，无法锁定浮动利润
cons_en: Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same candle leading to overtrading
No spread filter, which may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread market conditions
Fixed lot sizing without money management logic cannot dynamically adjust based on account size and risk
WPR tends to generate consecutive false signals in trending markets, leading to successive losses
No trailing stop or partial close mechanism to lock in floating profits
improvements: 添加新K线检查以防止同一K线重复开仓，减少过度交易风险
引入基于账户余额的动态仓位管理，根据风险百分比自动计算手数
improvements_en: Add a new bar check to prevent repeated entries on the same candle, reducing overtrading risk
Introduce dynamic position sizing based on account balance, automatically calculating lot size according to risk percentage

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查可能导致同一K线多次开仓，增加过度交易风险
没有传播过滤在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
固定手数不适应不同账户规模，小账户可能承受过大风险
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause multiple entries on the same candle, increasing overtrading risk
No spread filter may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread conditions
Fixed lot sizing doesn't adapt to different account sizes, potentially exposing small accounts to excessive risk
